text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired for tenant sunset.ai — reserved-pool-latency > 300ms (policy: reserved-pool-latency-high). link: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/alerts/tenant-sunset

pagerduty: PagerDuty: Incident #PD-78943 — page triggered, escalation policy: eng-oncall. Auto-escalation in 6m if not acked.

sam (oncall): acked — I'm on it. gathering quick metrics.

sam (oncall): grafana shows 95th p99 spike ~420ms for generate_text route, error rate up from 0.2% -> 3.8%. 5xxs primarily 502 gateway from dedicated pool.

mira (sre): pinging infra slack, could be reserved pool node saturation or KV cache thrash. mira here, adding context.

ops-bot: Note: tenant sunset.ai is on reserved-pool 'eu-west-2-reserved-07', capacity commit 8 GPUs, current util 98%. KV cache evictions increased x15.

sam (oncall): rolling up logs: tail from runtime shows token OOM retries and request queueing:
```
2026-03-15T10:12:01Z runtime: request enqueue delay 240ms tenant=sunset.ai
2026-03-15T10:12:03Z kvcache: evict miss count 1234 tenant=sunset.ai
2026-03-15T10:12:05Z serving: fallback to variant small-int8 tenant=sunset.ai
```

jia (infra): can we burst to shared spare capacity? I'll try routing some traffic to 'dedicated-burst-eu' pool. giving Jia permission to mutate routing.

jia (infra): running routing command now: `redwoodctl route modify --tenant sunset.ai --split 70:30 --pools eu-west-2-reserved-07,dedicated-burst-eu` — applying.

sam (oncall): :white_check_mark: route change applied. watching latency/5xx.

emily (solutions): pinging customer success — Sunrise (customer contact) said they saw timeouts from some users, but no mass outage yet. will open support ticket.

ops-bot: Routing change took effect. Traffic split 70/30. Post-change metrics in 60s.

sam (oncall): after split: p95 down from 420ms -> 260ms, 5xx reduced 3.8% -> 1.1%. KV evictions falling. Good sign.

mira (sre): still seeing occasional spikes when long sequences hit unquantized kernels. proposing temporary autoscale add +2 GPUs to pool (reserved burst).

jia (infra): scaling reserved pool by 2 now: `redwoodctl pool scale --pool eu-west-2-reserved-07 --add 2 --reason "autopage - latency"`

ops-bot: Scale request accepted, new target 10 GPUs. Allocation ETA ~90s.

sam (oncall): note: PD auto-escalation canceled — incident acknowledged and mitigation in flight. tagging PD incident as 'in progress'.

emily (solutions): filing customer-facing note: "We've detected increased latency for your dedicated cluster; we've routed part of traffic to burst capacity and are scaling reserve; minimal impact expected. Will follow up."

ops-bot: Scale completed. pool eu-west-2-reserved-07 now 10 GPUs.

sam (oncall): with added capacity p95 stable ~180ms, p99 ~300ms, 5xx ~0.4%. marking initial mitigation successful.

mira (sre): good — I'm leaving a temporary rule to prefer quantized variants for sunset.ai for next 2 hours: `config deploy --tenant sunset.ai --model-pref quantized --ttl 2h`

sam (oncall): Applied. Also enabled additional KV prefetching for common prompts.

emily (solutions): customer updated. asking for any user-facing incident number? we can provide PD-78943 ref.

sam (oncall): yep send PD-78943. I'll keep monitoring for 30m then handoff to next oncall.

mira (sre): follow-ups to file: (1) investigate KV cache sizing + eviction root cause, (2) consider transparent autoscale policy for reserved pools before paging, (3) rehearse cross-pool routing for tenants. I'll create tickets.

jia (infra): noting that burst pool's tail latency is slightly higher; we should add capacity there for predictable bursts. creating infra ticket.

ops-bot: pagerduty: Incident PD-78943 updated: Mitigation in place, acknowledged by sam (oncall). Estimated recovery: yes.

sam (oncall): wrapping — last check p95=170ms, p99=280ms, 5xx=0.3%. leaving monitoring watch for 45m. handing to mira for post-incident follow-up and next-shift handoff.

mira (sre): taking handoff. I'll run a deeper check, will open RFC for cache sizing.

emily (solutions): thanks team — sending customer update and adding support ticket link.

sam (oncall): closing slack thread once PD marked resolved. good job :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Reminder: create post-incident note within 24h and link PD incident.

mira (sre): will do. adding timeline + commands executed to the incident doc.

ops-bot: Reaction summary: :white_check_mark: mitigated, :hourglass_flowing_sand: monitoring, :spiral_note_pad: post-incident tasks created.
